definitions.explanation: The place or door through which you enter a building or area.

examples.japanese: {入|い}り{口|ぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っていて→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: Let's meet at the station entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入|い}り{口|ぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The entrance to this building is on the right.

examples.japanese: {入|い}り{口|ぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飾|かざ}ってあって→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: There were large flowers displayed in front of the entrance, and it was very beautiful.

notes:
{入|い}り{口|ぐち} means entrance or entry point. Compound of ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to enter) + ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth/opening).

WRITING:
Often written as {入口|いりぐち} without the り, especially on signs.

TYPES OF ENTRANCES:
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧{入|い}り{口|ぐち}: main/front entrance
- ⟦{裏|うら}{口|ぐち}→裏口：04101_uraguchi⟧: back entrance
- ⟦{通用口|つうようぐち}→通用口：20472_tsuuyouguchi⟧: staff/service entrance
- ⟦{搬入口|はんにゅうぐち}→搬入口：noentry⟧: loading entrance
- ⟦{非常口|ひじょうぐち}→非常口：07045_hijouguchi⟧: emergency exit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧: exit

OTHER 〜{口|ぐち} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{改札口|かいさつぐち}→改札口：09552_kaisatsuguchi⟧: ticket gate
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: counter, window (service)
- ⟦{出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}→出入り口：21070_deiriguchi⟧: doorway, entrance/exit

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {入|い}り{口|ぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Where is the entrance?
- {入|い}り{口|ぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait at the entrance
